name: expense-tracker-monorepo
description: GitHub-ready full-stack mini expense tracker with strong CI/CD quality

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @expense-tracker/shared && npm run lint --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run lint --workspace @expense-tracker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @expense-tracker/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @expense-tracker/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @expense-tracker/shared && npm run test --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run test --workspace @expense-tracker/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @expense-tracker/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace @expense-tracker/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @expense-tracker/shared && npm run build --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run build --workspace @expense-tracker/web
scripts.migrate: npm run prisma:generate --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace @expense-tracker/api
scripts.seed: npm run prisma:generate --workspace @expense-tracker/api && npm run prisma:seed --workspace @expense-tracker/api
